_comment: Skills from other projects that pair well with this kit. They are NOT vendored.
Vendoring would mean carrying someone else's licence obligations, re-merging by hand
every time they ship a fix, and growing this repo by megabytes for files most users
never open. `node scripts/install-skills.mjs <id>` fetches one on demand instead, and
records where it came from in a NOTICE.md beside it.
The kit's own skills live in skills/<name>/SKILL.md and are always present.
Adding an entry: `licenseFile` is required UNLESS you set `unlicensed: true`.
The installer used to refuse outright when an upstream had no licence file. That rule
was written for VENDORING and was being applied to FETCHING, which is a different act:
nothing here is copied into this repo, the files land on the user's own disk, and these
upstreams publish install commands inviting exactly that. `unlicensed: true` installs
and states the restriction — local copy fine, redistribution not. Carrying unlicensed
work inside THIS repo is still refused, and that half of the rule has not moved.
`via: "skills"` hands off to `npx skills add <repo>` instead of walking the contents
API. Use it when the repo is a project rather than a handful of markdown files: the API
walk is one request per file against a 60/hour anonymous limit.

seo.summary: Audits and fixes on-page SEO: meta tags, Open Graph, JSON-LD, sitemap, robots.txt.
seo.why: Markdown only — no API keys, no MCP server, no subscription. Everything it does, it does by reading and editing files, which is why it fits a kit that installs nothing.

taste.summary: Design judgement for generated interfaces — layout, type, spacing, motion.
taste.why: Video templates in this kit are HTML and CSS, so the same judgement applies to a 9:16 frame as to a web page.

imagegen-web.summary: Prompts for generating design comps and interface imagery.
imagegen-web.why: For the cover and in-frame images a post or video needs, when a stock search returns nothing usable.

brandkit.summary: Builds a consistent brand kit — palette, type scale, logo direction.
brandkit.why: Feeds the theme system: a palette decided once becomes a `theme` entry every template reads.

mkt-context.summary: Foundation context: product, audience, positioning. Upstream says run this first.
mkt-context.why: Every other marketing skill reads it, and it is the same information a PLAYBOOK.md already asks for — fill it once.

mkt-calendar.summary: Builds a content calendar from a goal and a channel mix.
mkt-calendar.why: Feeds the queue this kit already schedules from, instead of deciding topics one post at a time.

mkt-video-script.summary: Video scripts with hook, beats and CTA.
mkt-video-script.why: The narrative half of a script.json — the kit already handles the render half.

mkt-ad-copy.summary: Ad copy: headlines, primary text, variants to test.
mkt-ad-copy.why: What actually goes into the campaigns the Pipeboard MCP servers manage.

mkt-ads-audit.summary: Audits a live ad account and says what to cut, keep or scale.
mkt-ads-audit.why: Pairs directly with the ads MCP: it reads the numbers, this reads the meaning.

mkt-design.summary: One design skill covering eight output types — logo, campaign visual, infographic, social post.
mkt-design.why: Covers the image side that `imagegen-web` and `brandkit` do not: campaign assets rather than interfaces.

fb-humanizer.summary: Strips AI tells from a post and audits it against a Facebook checklist.
fb-humanizer.why: The English half this kit deliberately left out: em-dash rules and vocabulary swaps (leverage → use). Its forensic tier is built in already; install this when you write English, where those style rules apply.

fb-hook-extractor.summary: Reverse-engineers the hook from a post that already performed.
fb-hook-extractor.why: VIDEO_GENRES states hook principles; this dissects real posts against ten named formulas. Studying what worked beats reasoning about what should.

vibe-motion.summary: 13 motion skills: ruler progress, CLI typing, vinyl player, candlestick, three.js earth, spotlight reveal, SVG assembly.
vibe-motion.why: Recipes for motion this kit has no equivalent of. Most target Remotion or three.js rather than the html backend, so treat them as a source of technique — several are already re-implemented natively here (frame-terminal is claude-typer's idea in CSS).

video-shotcraft.sizeNote: 181 MB — it ships a full Remotion project, a gallery and demo renders. Expect a slow install.
video-shotcraft.summary: 104 shot recipe cards plus a production-ready cinematic product-video template, for Remotion.
video-shotcraft.why: The kit has genre sequences but no vocabulary for motion WITHIN a scene. Pairs with the `remotion` backend; the html backend cannot run its components.

fb-repurposer.summary: Rewrites a LinkedIn post, X thread, blog or newsletter as a native Facebook Page post.
fb-repurposer.why: The reference behind this kit's own `repurpose` skill. Useful directly if Facebook Pages are a channel you actually publish to.

_marketing: The six mkt-* entries are a selection from minhnv0807/ai-business-skills, which ships 63 skills across
marketing, personal branding and design, in Vietnamese (skills/vi) and English
(skills/en). Only the ones that plug into this kit's loop are listed — content
calendar in, ad copy out, ads audit back into what to write next.
To add another: copy an entry, change `path` to skills/vi/<folder> or skills/en/<folder>.
_facebook: The three fb-* entries come from sergebulaev/facebook-skills (MIT, 8 skills, part of a family that also
covers LinkedIn, Instagram, X, YouTube, TikTok and Threads).
Two things to know before installing any of them:
1. They are written for FACEBOOK PAGES IN ENGLISH. The voice rules, the under-80
character sweet spot and the vocabulary lists are English-language conventions. This
kit publishes Vietnamese, so treat them as a second opinion rather than as house rules.
2. Two skills NOT listed here — fb-audience-insights and fb-engagement-drafter — need a
paid Apify token to read real Page data. They are left out on purpose: everything in
this registry should be runnable without a subscription.
